\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്യുക} (viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka)}{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച ചെയ്യുക (viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka)}]{\ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്യുക} (viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka) — to compromise}

\label{lesson:ML-C452-vittuvilca-ceyyuka}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to threaten, then the Malayalam for to hesitate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}}
\textbf{\ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}} — \emph{viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka} — \textquotedblleft{}to compromise\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{രണ്ട്} \ml{കൂട്ടരും} \ml{കുറച്ച്} \ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്തു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{raṇṭŭ kūṭṭaruṁ kuṟaccŭ viṭṭuvīḻca ceytu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Both sides compromised a little.
\end{quote}

Past: \ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്തു}, \emph{viṭṭuvīḻca ceytu}.

The noun \ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} is a compromise.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}} (\emph{viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka}) is a phrase verb on a native Malayalam compound: \ml{വിടുക}, \textquotedblleft{}to let go\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 5393), and \ml{വീഴ്ച}, \textquotedblleft{}a fall\textquotedblright{}, from \ml{വീഴുക} (DEDR 5430), with \ml{ചെയ്യുക}, \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}: letting go and giving way.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{raṇṭŭ kūṭṭaruṁ kuṟaccŭ viṭṭuvīḻca ceytu.} — Both sides compromised a little.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to threaten, then the Malayalam for to hesitate, then say \emph{viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്യുക} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To compromise\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ്} (ottutīrppŭ)}{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ് (ottutīrppŭ)}]{\ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ്} (ottutīrppŭ) — a settlement}

\label{lesson:ML-C452-ottutirppu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to hesitate, then the Malayalam for to compromise.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ്}}
\textbf{\ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ്}} — \emph{ottutīrppŭ} — \textquotedblleft{}a settlement\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ഒടുവിൽ} \ml{രണ്ട്} \ml{കുടുംബങ്ങളും} \ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പിലെത്തി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{oṭuvil raṇṭŭ kuṭumbaṅṅaḷuṁ ottutīrppiletti.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
At last the two families reached a settlement.
\end{quote}

To reach a settlement is \ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പിലെത്തുക}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ്}} (\emph{ottutīrppŭ}) is a native Malayalam compound: \ml{ഒത്ത്}, \textquotedblleft{}together, in agreement\textquotedblright{}, and \ml{തീർപ്പ്}, \textquotedblleft{}a settling, a decision\textquotedblright{}, from \ml{തീരുക}, \textquotedblleft{}to be settled, to be finished\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 3278).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ottutīrppŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ottutīrppŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{oṭuvil raṇṭŭ kuṭumbaṅṅaḷuṁ ottutīrppiletti.} — At last the two families reached a settlement.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to hesitate, then the Malayalam for to compromise, then say \emph{ottutīrppŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A settlement\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ഉടമ്പടി} (uṭampaṭi)}{ഉടമ്പടി (uṭampaṭi)}]{\ml{ഉടമ്പടി} (uṭampaṭi) — a treaty; a pact}

\label{lesson:ML-C452-utampati}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to compromise, then the Malayalam for a settlement.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ഉടമ്പടി}}
\textbf{\ml{ഉടമ്പടി}} — \emph{uṭampaṭi} — \textquotedblleft{}a treaty; a pact\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{രണ്ട്} \ml{രാജ്യങ്ങളും} \ml{ഒരു} \ml{ഉടമ്പടിയിൽ} \ml{ഒപ്പുവെച്ചു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{raṇṭŭ rājyaṅṅaḷuṁ oru uṭampaṭiyil oppuveccu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The two countries signed a treaty.
\end{quote}

To sign one is \ml{ഉടമ്പടിയിൽ} \ml{ഒപ്പുവെക്കുക}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ഉടമ്പടി}} (\emph{uṭampaṭi}) is native Dravidian: DEDR 945 lists Malayalam \emph{uṭam-paṭi}, \textquotedblleft{}agreement, contract\textquotedblright{}, beside \emph{uṭan}, \textquotedblleft{}together with\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{uṭampaṭi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{uṭampaṭi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{raṇṭŭ rājyaṅṅaḷuṁ oru uṭampaṭiyil oppuveccu.} — The two countries signed a treaty.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to compromise, then the Malayalam for a settlement, then say \emph{uṭampaṭi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ഉടമ്പടി} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A treaty; a pact\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{സമീപനം} (samīpanaṁ)}{സമീപനം (samīpanaṁ)}]{\ml{സമീപനം} (samīpanaṁ) — an approach; an attitude to}

\label{lesson:ML-C452-samipanam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a settlement, then the Malayalam for a treaty.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{സമീപനം}}
\textbf{\ml{സമീപനം}} — \emph{samīpanaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}an approach; an attitude to\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{പ്രശ്നത്തോട്} \ml{അവരുടെ} \ml{സമീപനം} \ml{വളരെ} \ml{നല്ലതായിരുന്നു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{praśnattōṭŭ avaruṭe samīpanaṁ vaḷare nallatāyirunnu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Their approach to the problem was very good.
\end{quote}

Towards something: -\ml{ഓട്} \ml{സമീപനം}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{സമീപനം}} (\emph{samīpanaṁ}) is built on Sanskrit \emph{samīpa}, \textquotedblleft{}near\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 13226), with the noun ending -\ml{അനം}: an approach is a way of coming near a thing.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{samīpanaṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{samīpanaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{praśnattōṭŭ avaruṭe samīpanaṁ vaḷare nallatāyirunnu.} — Their approach to the problem was very good.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a settlement, then the Malayalam for a treaty, then say \emph{samīpanaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{സമീപനം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An approach; an attitude to\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{സഹകരണം} (sahakaraṇaṁ)}{സഹകരണം (sahakaraṇaṁ)}]{\ml{സഹകരണം} (sahakaraṇaṁ) — cooperation}

\label{lesson:ML-C452-sahakaranam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a treaty, then the Malayalam for an approach.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{സഹകരണം}}
\textbf{\ml{സഹകരണം}} — \emph{sahakaraṇaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}cooperation\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{നാട്ടുകാരുടെ} \ml{സഹകരണം} \ml{കൊണ്ട്} \ml{പണി} \ml{വേഗം} \ml{തീർന്നു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nāṭṭukāruṭe sahakaraṇaṁ koṇṭŭ paṇi vēgaṁ tīrnnu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
With the local people's cooperation, the work finished quickly.
\end{quote}

As an adjective it comes first: \ml{സഹകരണ} \ml{ബാങ്ക്}, a cooperative bank.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{സഹകരണം}} (\emph{sahakaraṇaṁ}) is borrowed from Sanskrit \emph{sahakaraṇa}, \textquotedblleft{}acting together\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): \emph{saha}, \textquotedblleft{}together\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{karaṇa}, \textquotedblleft{}doing\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sahakaraṇaṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sahakaraṇaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nāṭṭukāruṭe sahakaraṇaṁ koṇṭŭ paṇi vēgaṁ tīrnnu.} — With the local people's cooperation, the work finished quickly.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a treaty, then the Malayalam for an approach, then say \emph{sahakaraṇaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 445–452 — a review}

\label{lesson:ML-R452-review-445-452}



\begin{quote}
Say the Malayalam for inevitable and crucial.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item inevitable, crucial, fundamental, serious, complex
  \item evident, common, effective, logical, reliable
  \item to achieve, quality standard, to be defeated, to aim at, efficiency
  \item a crisis, a challenge, an obstacle, to analyse, a method
  \item to control, to go up, to increase, to go higher, to lift up
  \item to lower, to ensure, to protect, to improve, to wrap up
  \item to interfere, to insist, to put on record, to threaten, to hesitate
  \item to compromise, a settlement, a treaty, an approach, cooperation
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Inevitable? (\textbf{\ml{അനിവാര്യമായ}}, \emph{anivāryamāya}.) Crucial? (\textbf{\ml{നിർണ്ണായകമായ}}, \emph{nirṇṇāyakamāya}.) Fundamental? (\textbf{\ml{അടിസ്ഥാനപരമായ}}, \emph{aṭisthānaparamāya}.) Serious? (\textbf{\ml{ഗുരുതരമായ}}, \emph{gurutaramāya}.) Complex? (\textbf{\ml{സങ്കീർണ്ണമായ}}, \emph{saṅkīrṇṇamāya}.) Evident? (\textbf{\ml{വ്യക്തമായ}}, \emph{vyaktamāya}.) Common? (\textbf{\ml{പൊതുവായ}}, \emph{potuvāya}.) Effective? (\textbf{\ml{ഫലപ്രദമായ}}, \emph{phalapradamāya}.) Logical? (\textbf{\ml{യുക്തിസഹമായ}}, \emph{yuktisahamāya}.) Reliable? (\textbf{\ml{വിശ്വസനീയമായ}}, \emph{viśvasanīyamāya}.) To achieve? (\textbf{\ml{നേടുക}}, \emph{nēṭuka}.) Quality standard? (\textbf{\ml{ഗുണനിലവാരം}}, \emph{guṇanilavāraṁ}.) To be defeated? (\textbf{\ml{പരാജയപ്പെടുക}}, \emph{parājayappeṭuka}.) To aim at? (\textbf{\ml{ലക്ഷ്യമിടുക}}, \emph{lakṣyamiṭuka}.) Efficiency? (\textbf{\ml{കാര്യക്ഷമത}}, \emph{kāryakṣamata}.) A crisis? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രതിസന്ധി}}, \emph{pratisandhi}.) A challenge? (\textbf{\ml{വെല്ലുവിളി}}, \emph{velluviḷi}.) An obstacle? (\textbf{\ml{തടസ്സം}}, \emph{taṭassaṁ}.) To analyse? (\textbf{\ml{വിശകലനം} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}}, \emph{viśakalanaṁ ceyyuka}.) A method? (\textbf{\ml{രീതി}}, \emph{rīti}.) To control? (\textbf{\ml{നിയന്ത്രിക്കുക}}, \emph{niyantrikkuka}.) To go up? (\textbf{\ml{വർദ്ധിക്കുക}}, \emph{varddhikkuka}.) To increase? (\textbf{\ml{വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കുക}}, \emph{varddhippikkuka}.) To go higher? (\textbf{\ml{ഉയരുക}}, \emph{uyaruka}.) To lift up? (\textbf{\ml{ഉയർത്തുക}}, \emph{uyarttuka}.) To lower? (\textbf{\ml{താഴ്ത്തുക}}, \emph{tāḻttuka}.) To ensure? (\textbf{\ml{ഉറപ്പാക്കുക}}, \emph{uṟappākkuka}.) To protect? (\textbf{\ml{സംരക്ഷിക്കുക}}, \emph{saṁrakṣikkuka}.) To improve? (\textbf{\ml{മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്തുക}}, \emph{meccappeṭuttuka}.) To wrap up? (\textbf{\ml{അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുക}}, \emph{avasānippikkuka}.) To interfere? (\textbf{\ml{ഇടപെടുക}}, \emph{iṭapeṭuka}.) To insist? (\textbf{\ml{നിർബന്ധിക്കുക}}, \emph{nirbandhikkuka}.) To put on record? (\textbf{\ml{രേഖപ്പെടുത്തുക}}, \emph{rēkhappeṭuttuka}.) To threaten? (\textbf{\ml{ഭീഷണിപ്പെടുത്തുക}}, \emph{bhīṣaṇippeṭuttuka}.) To hesitate? (\textbf{\ml{മടിക്കുക}}, \emph{maṭikkuka}.) To compromise? (\textbf{\ml{വിട്ടുവീഴ്ച} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}}, \emph{viṭṭuvīḻca ceyyuka}.) A settlement? (\textbf{\ml{ഒത്തുതീർപ്പ്}}, \emph{ottutīrppŭ}.) A treaty? (\textbf{\ml{ഉടമ്പടി}}, \emph{uṭampaṭi}.) An approach? (\textbf{\ml{സമീപനം}}, \emph{samīpanaṁ}.) Cooperation? (\textbf{\ml{സഹകരണം}}, \emph{sahakaraṇaṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
